title: Direct PR review intake through Command Center
description: Use a disabled validation slot and an unavailable account to prove real UI submission, inherited execution, live QA selection, visible provider failure and cancellation. Set INTAKE_PR_URL, INTAKE_PROJECT, INTAKE_SLOT and GW_URL in the recipe environment.

check-existing-work.intent: Refuse to interfere with existing operator intake for this PR.

prepare-team.intent: Create or refresh the disabled-slot validation team through real RPCs and clean its setup request.

open-prs.intent: Open the real connected PR dashboard.

wait-panel.intent: Persistent monitoring stays accessible when the PR discovery dashboard cannot load.

enter-pr.intent: The individual review targets the supplied PR without depending on an originating Farmslot run.

choose-team.intent: The request inherits the disabled-slot validation team policy.

override-review.intent: Choose explicit review and QA settings while inheriting the disabled slot.

choose-live.intent: Require live QA while continuing the saved reviewer context.

submit-request.intent: Submit through the production intake API.

wait-request.intent: Verify provider failure is visible on the persisted request.

verify-request.intent: Assert the gateway received the selected team, Continue and live QA settings, with no dispatch.

capture-request.intent: Reviewers can inspect the persisted failure state and available cancellation control.

cancel-request.intent: Cancel the request using its real UI control.

verify-cancelled.intent: Verify cancellation persisted and no work is queued.
